\section{Reference oscillator}
The measured period \(T>0\), cyclic frequency \(f\), and angular frequency \(\omega\) all describe the same reference oscillator. Converting the measured period gives
\[f = \frac{1}{T}.\]
Using that frequency for the same oscillation then gives
\[\omega = 2\pi f.\]

\section{Draft optimizer}
For differentiable loss \(J\), the iterate \(\theta_k\), next iterate \(\theta_{k+1}\), scalar step \(\eta\), and gradient \(g_k=
abla J(\theta_k)\) share the stated parameter space. The draft update is
\[\theta_{k+1}=\theta_k-\eta g_k.\]
